title: dedicated-autoscaler-add-backpressure-and-utilization-reporting-fix
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: We observed tail-end over-provisioning during large short-lived bursts in Dedicated fleets. The autoscaler would react to transient utilization spikes driven by burst tokens and sometimes spin up extra nodes that were immediately underutilized, increasing cost and churn. This PR introduces a lightweight backpressure/smoothing mechanism in the Dedicated autoscaler and corrects a couple of issues in utilization reporting that caused burst-driven utilization to be double-counted in the fleet metrics. Changes include: 1) tokenbucket-aware backpressure: autoscaler now applies a short smoothing window and a conservative scale-up path when the high utilization is primarily caused by burst tokens. 2) Corrected utilization aggregation: decouple burst-capacity utilization from baseline utilization reporting so capacity dashboards and billing signals reflect true sustained load. 3) New metrics: autoscaler.backpressure_events, autoscaler.scale_decision_reason, autoscaler.prefers_burst_delta; added tags for fleet_id and priority. 4) Observability: updated Grafana dashboard panels, alert tuning (reduced false positives from transient bursts). 5) Tests: end-to-end integration test that simulates bursts and validates no unnecessary scaling, unit tests for smoothing logic, updated load-testing harness script. 6) Docs: updated dedicated/autoscaler.md with configuration knobs (backpressure_window_ms, burst_scale_factor, min_scale_cooldown). CI: initial run revealed a flaky integration test (TestAutoscaleBurstScenario) due to timing assumptions; fixed by using event-driven hooks instead of sleep-based polling; subsequent CI run passed. Release notes: include guidance for Dedicated operators about new knobs and recommended defaults; rolling update recommended to avoid mid-scale race conditions.
commits: feat(autoscaler): add backpressure/smoothing and tokenbucket-aware scale decisions; fix(util): correct utilization aggregation for burst tokens; test: add integration test for burst scenarios; docs: add configuration and operational guidance; ci: stabilize TestAutoscaleBurstScenario
changed_files_summary: Key changes: new backpressure window + conservative scale-up path in autoscaler; fix to aggregation.go to subtract burst token utilization before computing sustained utilization; added metrics and dashboard updates; tests and CI stabilization.

release_notes: Fixed autoscaler over-provisioning during short bursts by adding backpressure/smoothing. New config knobs: backpressure_window_ms (default 5000), burst_scale_factor (default 0.25), min_scale_cooldown_ms. Observability: added autoscaler.backpressure_events metric and updated Dedicated autoscaler dashboard. Recommended rolling update for Dedicated fleets to pick up aggregation fixes.
notes_for_ops: Operators should monitor autoscaler.backpressure_events for >10/min sustained bursts; if observed, consider tuning burst_scale_factor or increasing burst token capacity. Rolling update recommended to avoid mid-scale race windows.
